title: Mock 106 - Fill in the Blanks Level 1
category: Most Repetitive Questions/Fill in the Blanks/Level 1

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 is 'consists'. The word 'consists' is the most appropriate choice in the given context as it accurately reflects the idea that the human psyche is composed of the ego, the super ego, and the id. The other options do not fit the context. 'Desires' means to wish for. 'Lacks' means to have none or not enough of something. 'Grapples' means to struggle with or work hard to deal with something. These options do not fit the context of the sentence and are thus negated.

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is 'aware'. The sentence 'The ego forms the part of our conscious mind which we work with and are most aware of' suggests that the ego is something we actively engage with and have knowledge of in our conscious mind. The word 'aware' (knowing about or realising something) is the appropriate choice as it accurately captures the idea that we have consciousness and knowledge about the ego, its functions, and its influence on our behaviour and decisions. The other options do not fit the context and are thus negated.

Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3 is 'basis'. The sentence 'The super ego forms our conscience in the form of the unconscious and works on the basis of social and cultural influences' implies that the super ego operates based on social and cultural influences, shaping our conscience and moral standards. The word 'basis' accurately conveys this sense of the underlying principles or fundamental influences on which the super ego operates. The other options do not fit the context and are thus negated.

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is 'repressed'. In the context of the sentence, the word 'repressed' accurately describes the nature of the thoughts, desires, and dreams contained within the subconscious. 'Repressed' (having feelings that you do not express) implies that these elements are suppressed or kept hidden from the conscious mind, often due to psychological or emotional reasons. The other options do not fit the context and are thus negated.

'Sanctioned' means to give official permission for something.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5 is 'bizarre'. The word 'bizarre' means very strange, unusual, or strikingly odd. In the context of the sentence, the word 'bizarre' accurately describes the unusual or strange nature of the scenes or images found in the subconscious. The other options do not fit the context. 'Parallel' means occurring or existing alongside something else in the same plane and having the same distance between corresponding points. 'Constricted' means narrowed, especially as a result of pressure. 'Concurrent' means existing, happening, or done at the same time. So, these options are negated.

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
The helping verb 'has' is always followed by the past participle form (V3) of the verb. Only option (c) 'become' is the past participle form.

Hence, option (c) is the answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution:
The blank requires an adjective to denote teenagers' state with respect to academic stress. So, option (d) 'resistance' (a noun) is eliminated.

When 'scared + preposition' is followed by the thing that scares someone, the preposition generally used is 'of', not 'to' (that follows the blank). So, option (a) is incorrect.

Liable - responsible by law; legally answerable. The statement does not imply that it is the responsibility of teenagers to take stress. So, option (c) is not correct.

Filling the blank with 'prone' implies that teenagers are most likely to suffer academic stress.

This is both grammatically and contextually correct.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
Collateral - property that someone borrowing money will give to the loan company, if he or she cannot pay the debt

Intervention - the action of becoming intentionally involved in a difficult situation, in order to improve it or prevent it from getting worse

Convention - a way in which something is usually done.

Physical - relating to the body as opposed to the mind.

The sentence with the third blank discusses the type of solutions that are required to deal with academic stress.

Here, words like 'collateral', 'convention', and 'physical' do not fit in contextually.

'Intervention solutions' would imply the direct involvement of those trying to help students with academic stress.

Hence, option (b) is the answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
questions.solution:
The sentence intends to convey the message that among all other aspects of a person's life, exams hold a prominent position.

Since the comparison is not between just two things, options (a) and (d) are incorrect.

'Eager' (which means 'strongly wanting to do or have something') is an adjective used for humans, and not for intangible things.

So, 'most crucial' fits best in the blank.

Hence, option (c) is the answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.solution:
The blank requires a noun to denote what everyone wants to avoid in their life. 'Sneak' (move or go in a furtive or stealthy way) does not fit in contextually.

The sentence implies that people do not want to fail any exam. So, saying that they want to avoid purpose does not fit in the context of the passage.

'Wanderlust' (which means 'a strong desire to travel') does not fit in the context of the passage.

Filling the blank with 'ambiguity' (means 'a situation or statement that is unclear because it can be understood in more than one way') implies that people want to avoid unclear situations in their life.

This fits in contextually.

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution: The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 is 'broaden'. "Broaden" means to make something wider or more extensive in scope, range, or understanding. In the context of the sentence, "broaden your horizons" means to expand your knowledge, experiences, or perspectives, especially by exploring new places, cultures, or ideas. Other words are not suitable for the blank. 'Constrict' means to make something narrower, tighter, or more limited in scope. 'Localise' means to confine or restrict something to a particular area or locality. 'Contract' means to become smaller, narrower, or reduced in size or scope. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution: The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is 'opportunity'. 'Opportunity' refers to a favourable or advantageous circumstance or situation that presents the possibility of achieving something desirable or beneficial. In the context of the sentence, it implies the chance to experience different types of food from various cultures while exploring new places. Other words are not suitable for the blank. A 'disadvantage' refers to a condition or circumstance that puts someone in an unfavourable or inferior position compared to others. A 'hindrance' is something that acts as an obstacle or impediment, slowing down or preventing progress or achievement. An 'obstacle' is a physical or non-physical barrier that stands in the way of progress or achievement. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution: The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3 is 'stay'. The sentence suggests that when traveling, it's important to remain calm and flexible. In this context, "stay" means to remain or continue in a particular state or condition, especially despite difficulties or challenges. Other words are not suitable for the blank. "Contract" means to become smaller or tighter. "Lose" means to experience defeat or failure. "Localise" means to confine or restrict something to a particular place or area, typically within a specific region or locality. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
questions.solution: The correct option to fill in blank number 4 is 'aspect'. "Aspect" refers to a particular part or feature of something. In the context of the sentence, it accurately conveys the idea of sustainability being a significant aspect or consideration in the context of travel. Other words are not suitable for the blank. 'Constant' refers to something that remains unchanged or consistent over time. 'Entirely' means completely or wholly, without exception. 'Detail' refers to one fact or piece of information. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.solution: The correct option to fill in blank number 5 is 'possibilities'. The sentence mentions that with so many options available, the world is yours to explore. The word "possibilities" fits this context as it suggests that the abundance of options or opportunities makes the world open to exploration and discovery. Other words are not suitable for the blank. 'Contaminants' are substances that pollute or make something impure, especially when introduced into the environment. 'Barriers' are obstacles or impediments that prevent or hinder progress or movement. 'Limitations' refer to restrictions or constraints that restrict one's actions or capabilities. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
questions.solution:
'Despite' itself means in spite of, so the use of 'of' after despite is redundant, so option (a) will be eliminated. 'In spite' is always followed by 'of' which is not the case here. So, option (c) will also get eliminated. 'Though' is used to show a contrast and 'despite' focus on the effects, here it mentions that people use drugs without thinking about the harmful consequences.

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
questions.solution:
The sentence talks about the effects of drugs on various entities so 'impacts' will be the right word to talk about its effects on societies as well.

'Imparts' means make known. 'Reflects' means think deeply or carefully about.

No other word can be used in the blank.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
questions.solution:
It is mentioned in the latter part of the sentence that 'drug addicts should be given proper medical treatment' so in the methods of prevention 'restricting (limiting) sales' is the right way to cure this habit of drug addiction.

'Promoting (to increase)' talks in the contradiction of prevention.

'Conducting' and 'performing' (both means to act) are not related with the given context.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
questions.solution:
'Regeneration' means the action or process of regenerating or being regenerated. 'Resignation' means a letter or statement that says you want to leave your job or position. 'Rehabilitation' means the process of returning to a healthy or good way of life. 'Regression' means a return to a previous and less advanced or worse state, condition, or way of behaving.

'Rehabilitation' is the word to fill the blank as it gives a context of returning to live a healthy life after the drug addiction. It goes with the meaning of the sentence. No other word can be used here.

Hence, option (c) is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
questions.solution:
'For' means belongs to. 'Of' is used to the purpose underlying or intended by speech, action, etc. 'From' means showing the place, direction or time that somebody/something starts or started. 'By' means beside; very near.

Here, 'of' will be the right preposition as the consumption belongs to the noun (drugs), so 'of' will be the right word to link that.

Hence, option (b) is correct.
